lines: I can't stop the loneliness
I can't hold it back — the sadness won't stop
I can't stop the loneliness
Why is it? The sadness won't stop
Introducing you to her —
even now I regret it
The two of you felt a kinship
at the café terrace that afternoon
That day the phone rang, out of nowhere
"Leave him," she said
I can't stop the loneliness
Why is it? The sadness won't stop
"It's a misunderstanding," you laugh
but your kiss smells of lies
Held in your arms, I realized
that love isn't here
Love is like a small storm
it steals away friends and lovers alike
I can't stop the loneliness
Give him back — the sadness won't stop
I can't stop the loneliness
Someone save me — the sadness won't stop
I can't stop the loneliness
I can't hold it back — the sadness won't stop
I can't stop the loneliness
Why is it? The sadness won't stop
